يتبحبح (form IIq)

# يُتَبَحْبَحُ (yutabaḥbaḥu) /ju.ta.baħ.ba.ħu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# يَتَبَحْبَحَ (yatabaḥbaḥa) /ja.ta.baħ.ba.ħa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَبَ
